description: He wears an opaque burgundy long coat with wide gold woven geometric borders along the front opening, cuffs and hem and narrower matching upper-arm bands. An ivory long tunic with fine gold neckline and hem trim lies underneath. A brown leather belt with ornate round gold fittings sits at the waist, and a small chain of decorative belt pendants hangs below. Dark brown trousers and tall brown leather boots are fully visible. The coat appears substantial with a softly textured sheen; precise fiber cannot be established. No shoulder mantle, headgear, weapons or armor are visible.
